999008199.text: ――所信表明演説、２日前

よし、本番の演説の内容はおおよそ決まったな。
あとは練習あるのみだ

localizations.en: Good. We've more or less settled on the content for the main speech. Now we just need to practice.

999008199.text:
もう明後日が本番かあ……
ううう……緊張してきたー

localizations.en: The big day is already the day after tomorrow... Oooh... I'm getting nervous!

999008199.text: 大丈夫ですよ。良い原稿に仕上がったと思います

localizations.en: You'll be fine. I think we've put together a really solid script.

999008199.text:
街頭演説にも結構な人が集まっていましたし、
事前のアピールもしっかりできていると思います

localizations.en: We had quite a crowd at the street speech too, so I think our preliminary campaigning is going well.

999008199.text: お、集まってるね

localizations.en: Oh, looks like the gang's all here.

999008199.text: 頼まれていたもの、用意できました

localizations.en: I've prepared everything you asked for!

999008199.text: え、なんですか？

他の候補者の情報も集めてほしいって言われてね。
もろもろ資料にまとめておいたよ

localizations.en: You asked me to gather info on the other candidates, remember? I've compiled everything into these documents.

999008199.text:
助かりました。こちらは演説の内容を検討するので
手いっぱいでしたので

localizations.en: That's great. We've been so busy working on the speech that we didn't have time to handle that ourselves.

999008199.text:
結論から言うと……生徒会長選最大のライバルは
ロマンって奴だね

localizations.en: To cut to the chase... your biggest rival in this student council election is that Roman guy.

999008199.text: やはり……

選挙委員のほうで、事前の人気調査なんかも
やってたんだけど……ぶっちぎりの１位

localizations.en: The election committee was conducting some popularity polls beforehand... and it looks like he's leading by a landslide.

999008199.text:
街頭演説でも結構人集めてたもんね。
勝てるのかなあ……

localizations.en: He did attract quite a crowd during his street speeches too. I wonder if we can win...

999008199.text:
彼の公約は、「夢を実現できる学園にする」……
ユナと似ているようで、真逆の考え方ですね

localizations.en: His platform is 'creating an academy where dreams can be realized'... While it sounds similar to Juna's, the philosophy behind it is completely opposite.

999008199.text:
……ああ。彼は夢があることを何より
素晴らしいと思っている

localizations.en: ...Yes. He believes that having a dream is the most wonderful thing above all else.

999008199.text:
ちょっと乱暴な考え方かもしれませんけど……
賛同する人が多いのも分かります

localizations.en: It might be a somewhat simplistic way of thinking... but I can understand why many people would support it.

999008199.text: ミミちゃんと同じ考え方の人も多そうだしね

localizations.en: There are probably lots of people who are in Mimi's camp too.

999008199.text:
内容的にもライバルってわけだ。
ちょっとやりづらそうだねえ

localizations.en: So he's your rival in terms of platform too. It seems like we've got our work cut out for us.

999008199.text:
ひとまず、相手の情報は分かりました。
これを踏まえて、台本を整えましょう

localizations.en: Now that we have a better understanding of our opponent, let's use this information to refine our script.

999008199.text: そうだな。私たちは、やるべきことをやるだけだ

localizations.en: Agreed. All we can do is focus on what needs to be done.

999008199.text: ロロナ。当日はお互いに全力を尽くそう

localizations.en: Rorona. Let's both give it our all on the day.

999008199.text: ……うん！
